nodes.label: NOXES Full Logo (signal mark + wordmark)
nodes.content: Primary horizontal NOXES brand lockup (SVG, viewBox 450x128). Combines the vermilion (#E83708) signal mark - an abstract 'N' polyline with a filled terminal dot - enclosed by a graphite (#414548) four-corner bracket frame with square line caps, followed by the 'NOXES' wordmark in off-white (#F4F1E9), font-family Barlow Condensed/Inter, font-size 80, font-weight 900, letter-spacing 3 at (145,91). Accessible via role=img with aria-labelledby referencing title 'NOXES' and desc 'The NOXES logo, with a signal mark and wordmark.' The signal-mark path mirrors the standalone noxes-symbol.svg artwork (translated by 3,3), and the wordmark mirrors noxes-wordmark.svg.

nodes.label: NOXES brand visual identity system
nodes.content: Shared design language across the three brand assets: vermilion #E83708 as the signal/accent color, graphite #414548 for the squared four-corner bracket frame, off-white #F4F1E9 for lettering, and heavy uppercase Barlow Condensed (fallback Inter) typography. Recurring motif is an abstract 'N' signal with a terminal dot, framed by square corner brackets. The full logo combines the signal mark and wordmark; the symbol and wordmark are standalone variants of the same identity.
